Damien & small group of friends,

I am still waiting for an answer from you, Damien, about whether you will testify voluntarily. I emailed you and my lovely solicitor Mr Hussain some days ago. You sent me an Instagram message saying that you "haven't decided if I'll be bothered to go" (https://damien.chats.swhra.uk/#msg-ig-1786369977045). I think this is shameful. Please give me a clear answer. If you are not willing to tell the truth, say so.

- Sam

Damien, while you’re here and reading my messages, you could maybe:

- swing by our group chats with Oli, refresh your memory, and confirm that Oli was still calling himself my boyfriend and saying he loved me as late as April 16th
- swing by your chat with me, refresh your memory, and confirm that you said on May 9th that Oli wasn’t going to “leave” me and just wanted me to stop with the group chats (soz, no can do)
- swing by your own chat with Oli on the night of May 27th-28th– wait, no, sorry, you deleted it, my bad
- swing by your conscience

You have spent months mocking and betraying me. This is a disgrace. I am being prosecuted, you know the truth, and you have refused to say it (except to me privately / in calls now on YouTube and presumably somehow denied by you to others) so that Oli could cover up the double life that he had lived in respect of me and Sam Cherny (to whom hi again).

You have told me I should be put in prison, told me I will be put in prison, all for a case you admit is so specious that it should be thrown out (see below). I have known you for 12 years. It feels different writing this on Facebook. Why the fuck did you ever think this was ok?

"Do you think the judge is just going to take one look and throw it out? Because the whole thing's ridiculous." (youtu.be/MIXBADeyxWU?t=1158) 
"Do you think any court of law will take this any bit serious?" (youtu.be/ZOd0hsbyAHQ?t=2408) 
"This whole thing is so ugly and it should just be left. Will it even go to trial?!" (youtu.be/ZOd0hsbyAHQ?t=2493)

"Has your solicitor said they'll just... Do you think the judge will just look at this and think it's total nonsense and throw it away?" (youtu.be/ZOd0hsbyAHQ?t=5885)

I have known you since 2014. I knew you well enough that you were one of the slightly too many people who received a copy of Snoop Dogg’s cookbook from me for Christmas 2020: facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=10222379706339780 Do I have to make a public post? At what point has this gone far enough, Damien? You have lied both to and about me for months, and scorned the basic civic obligation of telling the truth in court. Whatever conscience you have has plainly malfunctioned.

God, I have recited this list of indictments so many times that they almost bore me. I know they bore you, because you’ve told me many times. Do you think I’m not bored of this? Do you think I enjoy saying this? I SHOULD NOT HAVE HAD TO SAY ANY OF THIS, DAMIEN. You should have done your most basic duty as a citizen, let alone a friend. Having failed, DO IT NOW.
Do you think this is a joke, Damien?
